home.welcomeDesc: Pick an instance to play, or create a new setup in Instances.
home.recentInstancesEmpty: No instances yet. Create one in Instances.
home.updatesLine1: 26.3.0: Fixed a false bridge timeout when starting a game download; the progress page now opens instantly
home.updatesLine2: 26.3.0: The standalone download progress window now refreshes in real time during every download stage
home.updatesLine3: 26.3.0: The fallback download path reports live progress as well and can be cancelled at any time
home.noticeLine1: Instances and Java are local data; nothing is downloaded
home.noticeLine2: Sign-in authenticates against the iGCraftLit website, so your iGMUid matches
home.libraryLine1: The library mirrors the website version list, grouped by year
home.libraryLine2: When sync fails the local cache is kept, so existing instances keep working

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Manage local Minecraft instances, versions and loaders
instances.emptyDesc: Create an instance to pick a Minecraft version, loader and launch options.
instances.filteredEmptyDesc: Adjust the keyword or filters and try again.

instances.confirmDeleteDesc: Instance "{name}" and its local configuration will be removed. This cannot be undone.

instances.scanNoVersion: This directory has no version that can be imported.

account.title: Account

account.registerDesc: Register on the iGCraftLit website, then sign in here.

accountMsBind.resultDone: Bound successfully, returning to the account page
accountMsBind.hint: Genuine tokens are encrypted at rest, never stored in plain text, and never exposed to the interface.

installer.languageDesc: Both the wizard and the installed launcher use this language; you can change it later in Launcher settings.
installer.termsDesc: Please read the terms in full; the agreement checkbox unlocks after you scroll to the bottom.
installer.termsScrollHint: Scroll to the bottom to continue
installer.termsSection1Body: An iGMUid is 11 digits: the first is the role digit (0 for admins and staff, 1-8 for regular users, 9 for test accounts) and the remaining 10 are a global sequence assigned in registration order. Accounts belong to the person who registered them and may not be transferred, lent or shared.
installer.termsSection2Body: Do not post illegal, infringing, pornographic, violent, discriminatory or deliberately inflammatory content; do not spam, abuse reports or direct messages; do not impersonate administrators or staff.
installer.termsSection3Body: You are responsible for what you publish and must hold the necessary rights. Minecraft-related resources must follow the licence terms of Mojang and of each loader or mod author.
installer.termsSection4Body: Direct messages are visible only to both participants; admins do not read them except when required by law or through the report handling process. Launcher data stays on your device.
installer.termsSection5Body: Depending on severity we may issue a warning, restrict features or ban the account. If you disagree with a decision you can appeal through the contact email.
installer.termsAgree: I have read and agree to the iGCraftLit User Terms
installer.installDirDesc: The launcher is installed into this directory (executable and resources); it is created if missing.
installer.shortcutNote: A desktop shortcut and a Start menu entry were created.
installer.errorTermsRequired: Read and accept the user terms first
